boundaries.name: \Gamma_H
boundaries.description: gas-side convective boundary (central 40% of the bottom edge) with heat transfer coefficient h_H and hot-fluid temperature u_H

boundaries.name: \Gamma_c
boundaries.description: air-cooling left and right edges exchanging heat with ambient air through coefficient h; their shape is optimised

boundaries.name: water wall
boundaries.description: top edge isothermal water-wall heat sink held at the prescribed reference temperature of zero kelvin

boundaries.name: bottom edge adiabatic
boundaries.description: remaining parts of the bottom edge, adiabatic (zero flux)

constants.name: k_0
constants.description: thermal conductivity of aluminium at u_amb

constants.name: h_H
constants.description: convective heat transfer coefficient (hot-fluid / gas side)

constants.name: q_b
constants.description: gas-side temperature weight, heat flux the gas side would absorb if the surface reached ambient temperature

objective.name: J(u)
objective.description: minimise the gas-side surface temperature at fixed material cost, i.e. maximize the heat recovered from the flue gas
terms: \int_{\Gamma_H} q_b u \,ds_x (gas-side surface temperature weighted by q_b)

state_equation.description: Non-linear steady heat conduction with temperature-dependent conductivity k(u) and Robin convection on the gas side \Gamma_H and cooling edges \Gamma_c; Dirichlet value 0 on the water wall.
state_equation.weak_form_lhs: \int_{D} k(u) \chi \left( \nabla u \cdot \nabla \delta u \right) \,dx + \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u \delta u \,ds_x
state_equation.weak_form_rhs: \int_{\Gamma_H} h_H u_{H} \delta u \,ds_x + \int_{\Gamma_c} h u_{amb} \delta u \,ds_x

optimization_config.level_set_initial: I-beam without holes: a full-width top flange (thickness 0.2) lying along the water wall, a bottom flange (length 0.5, thickness 0.2) under the gas-side footprint, and a web of width 0.2 running the full height between them.
optimization_config.rationale: hmin/hmax chosen for an O(1) domain to resolve the level-set interface and the thin I-beam features; diffusion 1e-4 is standard level-set regularisation; v0 1e-3 is a conservative extension velocity; 30 iterations balances cost and convergence for a 2D heat-sink shape optimisation; level_set_initial and mesh_file are carried from the extracted spec; boundary_labels/fixed_labels follow the extracted design roles: the Robin cooling edge Gamma_c is movable, while the adiabatic bottom edge, gas-side Robin edge, and Dirichlet water wall are fixed.
